summary.key_theme: Apple 正處於 iPhone 18 系列與摺疊機 Duo 的產品發布週期，市場對於高階需求與 AI 伺服器布局存在多空分歧。

bullish.title: Prediction: Even With the $1,999 Price Tag, Apple's Foldable iPhone Duo Will Be a Hit and Apple Will Join Nvidia in the $5 Trillion Club.
bullish.reason: 分析師看好高價位摺疊機 iPhone Duo 的市場潛力，認為其將推動 Apple 市值邁向 5 兆美元大關。

bullish.title: Apple gets bullish Wall Street call as iPhone demand jumps
bullish.reason: 基於消費者調查顯示 iPhone 需求強勁，華爾街分析師上調了 Apple 的目標價。

bullish.title: How to Play AAPL Stock Amid Reports Apple Is Building Its Own AI Server
bullish.reason: 報導指出 Apple 積極投入企業級 AI 伺服器領域，有助於強化其長期 AI 競爭力。

bullish.title: History Says You Should Know These 3 Things Before Buying Apple Stock (AAPL)
bullish.reason: 歷史數據顯示 Apple 股價表現強勁，投資人對其長期成長動能保持樂觀。

bullish.title: Jim Cramer sends strong signal to Apple stock investors
bullish.reason: 知名財經評論員 Jim Cramer 對 Apple 釋出正面訊號，影響市場情緒。

bullish.title: Apple begins iPhone 18 rollout ahead of its biggest premium bet yet: the foldable Duo
bullish.reason: Apple 啟動 iPhone 18 系列銷售，並預告高階摺疊機 Duo 即將上市，展現產品線擴張策略。

bullish.title: Bank of America does the math on Apple's $1,200 iPhone offer
bullish.reason: 銀行分析指出 Apple 提供高額換購優惠，有助於刺激消費者升級意願。

bullish.title: Apple (AAPL)’s New CEO Bets Big on a $1,999 Foldable iPhone
bullish.reason: 新任執行長推動高單價摺疊機策略，被視為公司轉型的重要里程碑。

bearish.title: John Ternus's First iPhone Launch Prompted a Bank of America Price Target Cut. Is Apple Stock a Buy?
bearish.reason: 由於記憶體處理器供應鏈緊張，導致 Bank of America 下調 Apple 目標價。

bearish.title: Apple Wants to Enter the AI Inference Market. It Will Have to Swallow Its Pride First.
bearish.reason: Apple 欲進入 AI 推論市場，但計畫仍需依賴競爭對手 Nvidia 的技術，顯示其自主性受限。

bearish.title: Apple’s iPhone 18 launch tests premium demand after big stock run
bearish.reason: 市場對 iPhone 18 Pro 的初期需求訊號呈現分歧，投資人擔憂高階市場需求疲軟。

bearish.title: Apple's new CEO says its AI already has your personal info
bearish.reason: 關於 Siri AI 存取個人隱私的疑慮，可能引發用戶對數據安全的負面觀感。

bearish.title: Greg Abel Recently Plowed $4.2 Billion Into Warren Buffett's Favorite Stock, and It Wasn't Apple
bearish.reason: 報導指出波克夏高層將資金投入其他標的而非 Apple，暗示機構投資人配置策略的轉變。

neutral.title: iPhone 18 Pro Hits Stores, Samsung Retakes Smartphone Throne and More: This Week in Appleverse
neutral.reason: 綜合報導本週 Apple 的多項動態，包含產品發布與競爭對手動向，屬於中性市場回顧。

neutral.title: Jim Cramer shares his expectations for Apple's new hardware releases
